title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals

monster.name: XOR Sprite
monster.title: Accumulator of Subsequence Bit Totals
monster.defeatQuote: Every subset's cumulative XOR sum was tallied!

description: The XOR total of an array is defined as the bitwise XOR of all its elements, or `0` if the array is empty. Given an array `nums`, return the sum of all XOR totals for every subset of `nums`.
solutionCode:
def subsetXORSum(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0
    def dfs(idx, curr_xor):
        nonlocal total
        if idx == len(nums):
            total += curr_xor
            return
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_xor ^ nums[idx])
        dfs(idx + 1, curr_xor)
    dfs(0, 0)
    return total
hints: At each element, choose whether to include it in the current subset XOR or exclude it.
